sn38.4:1.5: “But, reverend, what is the path and what is the practice for completely understanding this suffering?”
sn38.4:2.1: “This, reverend, is the noble eightfold path for completely understanding this suffering, that is—
sn38.4:2.3: This, reverend, is the path, this is the practice for completely understanding this suffering.”
sn38.4:2.4: “This path is good, reverend, this practice is better, for completely understanding this suffering.
sn38.4:2.5: And, reverend Sāriputta, don’t be heedless.”
